item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The actor is the general public, and the provision merely urges voluntary family contact and reconciliation; it imposes no governmental mandate or legal consequence.","evidence":"All Americans should encourage families and missing family members to get in touch with each other"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The provision hortatorily encourages missing family members to contact families or support organizations, with no mandatory government action or legal consequence.","evidence":"We should encourage missing family members to make direct contact with their families"},{"segment_id":"3","code":0,"rationale":"The segment combines a voluntary appeal to families with a recital of Congress's request for a commemorative proclamation; neither governs agencies nor alters legal rights.","evidence":"We also should encourage families whose ties are weak to seek out the programs which offer counseling and support to keep families together."},{"segment_id":"4","code":0,"rationale":"The President ceremonially designates a commemorative month, which the codebook treats as outside agency governance and legal-rights consequences.","evidence":"do hereby proclaim the period between May 13 and June 17, 1984, as Family Reunion Month."},{"segment_id":"5","code":0,"rationale":"The President makes a hortatory appeal for voluntary public celebration, creating no mandatory action or legal consequence.","evidence":"I call upon all Americans to celebrate this month with appropriate ceremonies and activities."}]}
